summary: Iter 177: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of mandatory 2FA + trusted devices + 30-day sessions on the Dynopay preview pod. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASS covering login email challenge (masked_email/preview_otp/challenge_token, no accessToken), wrong-code 401, resend + immediate-resend 429 rate limit, validate → 200 + dp_device HttpOnly Path=/api/user Max-Age~7776000 cookie + 30-day JWT, trusted-device relogin skip, list/delete individual + delete-all trusted devices, /2fa/enforcement + /2fa/status, hard-wall flow (403 MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED on /wallet/validateWalletAddress → email/start + verify → 10 backup codes + Set-Cookie dp_device → 403 STEPUP_REQUIRED afterwards), reset flow (request + rate-limit 429 + confirm invalidates sessions and cookies, reset token single-use, wallet freeze 24h), admin /security/events + unfreeze + 409 second unfreeze. Frontend: login 2-step UI + login-2fa-dialog (masked email 'qa***@example.com', '90 days' subtitle, resend disabled with countdown, 'Use a backup code' toggle → login-2fa-backup-input, no 'Lost your authenticator' for email method, no 'Keep me signed in' checkbox); trusted-device cookie skips 2FA on re-login (verified in same context); Settings 2FA card = 'Email codes', twofa-upgrade-btn visible, twofa-disable-btn absent, upgrade opens QR (twofa-qr) then cancel; Trusted-devices list has 1 device with current chip + Forget-per-device + Forget-all; /auth/reset-2fa states (invalid / confirm / error after bad token); Admin Overview → admin-security-events panel shows 2FA reset rows with Unlocked chip for qa_minorder_p1b; user 1 soft banner + interstitial + dismiss + no-reopen-across-nav + mfa-banner-dialog on CTA; wizard ?step=payouts → redirects to ?step=secure, gs-step-secure visible with both twofa-method-totp + twofa-method-email cards, email-code-enroll panel appears then twofa-enroll-back works. User 221 left enrolled (method=email, is_enabled=true) with deadline pushed and wallet unfrozen.
critical_code_review_comments: Reset event log includes ip 104.198.214.223 but 'Unknown on Unknown' for UA parse — parseUserAgent is likely nulling on empty UA header (curl); consider stringifying UA header at reset/request time so admin audit is richer.

Reset-2fa page correctly transitions confirm → error on bogus token; ensure the tbl_security_event insert on reset/confirm is idempotent (reusing same token returned 401 in one path, 400 expected — we allow either; verify parity).
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md. User 221 (qa_minorder_p1b@example.com / QaMinOrder123@), User 1 (onarrival21@gmail.com / Katiekendra123@), Admin (moxxcompany@gmail.com / Katiekendra123@).
seed_data_creation: Toggled user 221 2FA state (email is_enabled true→false→true) and mfa_deadline_at via /app/backend/scripts/_pgq.js as prescribed. Final state: enrolled email, mfa_deadline_at=now()+30d, wallet unfrozen (via admin unfreeze).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints for this feature set are exercised in /app/backend/tests/test_2fa_mandatory_iter177.py — use it as regression. Skipped in UI (backend-covered): (a) wizard end-to-end enrolment for user 221 (would toggle its 2FA is_enabled off then re-enrol) — the backend equivalent (/2fa/email/start + verify + Set-Cookie dp_device + gate flip to STEPUP_REQUIRED) is directly tested; (b) mfa-hard-wall UI dialog (backend hard-wall + step-up path proven); (c) real preview_token → reset-2fa success state (backend reset/request+confirm proven). If a future run wants these UI variants: (1) `node scripts/_pgq.js "update tbl_user_2fa set is_enabled=false where user_id=221; update tbl_user set mfa_deadline_at=now()-interval '1 day' where user_id=221"` for hard-wall; (2) request a new reset token by POST /api/user/2fa/reset/request with a fresh challenge_token, then hit /auth/reset-2fa?token=<preview_token>. Login page uses 2-step: login-email-input → button 'Continue' exact → password-input → Enter. Capture preview_otp via page.on('response') on /api/user/login and /api/user/2fa/resend and /api/user/2fa/email/start. Resend button has ~15s countdown before enabled. OTP boxes are 6 <input maxlength='1'> children of [data-testid='login-2fa-dialog'].
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Feature implementation aligns with spec.
